description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Generates a natural-language caption for an image using Llama 3.2-11B-Vision (Workers AI).

image.description: Image as base64 string or data URL (max 10MB binary).

prompt.description: Optional prompt; defaults to "Describe this image in one sentence."

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: ai_tools_image_caption
